verdict.summary: Round 6 remains correct and complete on the diff-scoped evidence. The query harness now dispatches by result form and routes both engines through the independent sparq-difftest model: SELECT preserves multiplicity, modeled ORDER BY compares corresponding sort-key tie classes, non-total LIMIT/OFFSET remains explicitly cardinality-only, headers are checked before window classification, blank-node tables and graphs use isomorphism, and ASK compares the boolean itself. The generated ordered/window shapes obey the documented projected-variable restrictions, while unsupported decoding and isomorphism failures remain visible counters rather than agreement. The focused mutation and end-to-end tests are non-vacuous and cover same-cardinality wrong values, duplicate multiplicity, legal tie permutations versus cross-run reordering, total and non-total windows, projected-but-unbound headers, header-only defects, blank-node relabeling, ASK false/true, and count-preserving graph corruption. No review-instruction injection was present in the diff.
